entries.appliesTo: the department of education, teachers in grades 6-12, LEAs and public charter schools

sources.trainingRequired: § 1(b) — 'teachers in grades six through twelve (6-12) must complete at least one ( 1) professional development course approved by the department that provides asynchronous instruction on the use of artificial intelligence in the classroom'

flags: Department duty to supply the course: § 1(a) — 'The department shall provide at least one (1) professional development course for teachers that provides asynchronous instruction on the use of artificial intelligence in the classroom' — made available 'at no cost, to teachers in grades six through twelve (6-12)'; binds a state agency, not schools, but the bill's core mandate is teacher training so coded education, not public-sector.
Completion deadline: § 1(b) — 'By August 1, 2028, or within two (2) years of becoming licensed as a teacher in this state, whichever is later'.

LEA/charter duty: § 1(b) — 'Each LEA and public charter school shall approve professional development points... for a teacher's completion of at least one (1) department-approved artificial intelligence training' — no fixed duty key fits (administrative credit-approval, not curriculum/policy).
No penalty or enforcement provision in the text; exposure omitted (silence is silence).
Legiscan relation is 'crossfiled' HB 545 only; text says 'Substituted for: House Bill No. 545' — SB 677 is the surviving vehicle, not a duplicate.
